solution.approach: In this work, we propose an approach for incorporating the shape-aware 2D/3D constraints into the 3D detection framework.

evidence.quote: In this work, we propose an approach for incorporating the shape-aware 2D/3D constraints into the 3D detection framework.
In this paper, we propose a novel approach to learn the meaningful keypoints on the object surface and then use them as additional geometrical constraints for 3D object detection.
Specifically, we design an automatic deformable model-fitting pipeline first to generate the 2D/3D correspondences for each object.

evidence.quote: The proposed framework has been verified on the public KITTI dataset and the experimental results demonstrate that by using additional geometrical constraints the detection performance has been significantly improved as compared to the baseline method.
More importantly, the proposed framework achieves state-of-the-art performance with real time.
